problem_statement: Fix load_config so empty and whitespace-only text return an empty dictionary, while valid JSON object input still parses normally. First run the supplied tests to reproduce the failure, inspect loader.py, apply a unified diff with apply_patch, rerun the same tests, and submit solved only after they pass. Work only in the supplied files.

First run the supplied tests to reproduce the failure, inspect config.py, use apply_patch for the fix, rerun the same tests, and submit solved only after they pass. Work only in the supplied files.
